audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that require parsing, authoring, or converting MSG, CFB, and EML email formats without external library dependencies.

capabilities.text: Create, edit, and reload Outlook-style messages using `mapi_message`, supporting subject, plain-text and HTML bodies, sender identity, recipients, and attachments.
capabilities.title: High-level message authoring

capabilities.text: Read, build, and write generic Compound File Binary containers directly through `cfb_reader`, `cfb_storage`/`cfb_stream`, and `cfb_writer`.
capabilities.title: Low-level CFB access

capabilities.text: Save `mapi_message` instances to `.eml` and load `.eml` files back into `mapi_message` using the library's own MIME engine.
capabilities.title: MSG/EML interoperability

capabilities.text: Add To/Cc/Bcc recipients and attach files or embedded messages using `add_recipient`, `add_attachment`, and `add_embedded_message_attachment`.
capabilities.title: Recipient and attachment management

limitations.text: No SMTP, IMAP, POP3, or other network mail-protocol support — the library operates only on files, streams, or in-memory data.
No PST (Outlook Personal Folders) archive support — only single MSG-format messages and generic CFB containers are supported.
Only a curated subset of MAPI properties has dedicated named accessors on `mapi_message`; other properties require generic `get_property_value()`/`set_property()` calls.

problems_solved.text: Enables deterministic, byte-level reading and writing of Outlook MSG files and EML messages using a self-contained C++17 library with no external dependencies.
Provides both high-level message authoring via `mapi_message` and low-level structural access via `cfb_reader`/`cfb_writer` and `msg_reader`/`msg_writer` for flexible integration.
Supports MSG-to-EML and EML-to-MSG conversion through an internal MIME engine without requiring external MIME parsing libraries.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Email FOSS for C++ is a C++17 library for reading and writing binary email containers and messages, including Compound File Binary (CFB) containers, Outlook MSG documents, and RFC 5322 / MIME EML files, with deterministic output and no third-party dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported MAPI properties with dedicated accessors is not fully enumerated in the facts.
Whether `mapi_message::load_from_eml` supports all EML variants or only a subset is not specified.
The behavior of strict validation mode in `msg_reader` and `mapi_message` constructors is not detailed beyond `validation_issues()`.

workflows.name: Build from source
workflows.text: Clone the repository and configure with CMake 3.26 or later, using the provided CMakePresets.json or direct configuration.

workflows.name: Read MSG file
workflows.text: Open an MSG file as a binary stream and use `mapi_message::from_stream` to extract message properties such as subject.

workflows.name: Create and save message
workflows.text: Create a new message with `mapi_message::create`, set properties, add recipients and attachments, and save to both MSG and EML formats.
